newsitem.title: FRANCE: Total jobless numbers fall in France in February.
newsitem.headline: Total jobless numbers fall in France in February.

text.p: The total number of people out of work in France fell by 7,500 in February to 3.09 million, the labour ministry said on Friday.

But economists said the figures did not necessarily show there was an improvement in unemployment, the blackspot in the French economy, since monthly data had become very volatile after the way of calculating it was changed last September.

The jobless rate, which is calculated differently and also based on International Labour Organisation criteria excluding jobseekers who did any work at all during the month, actually rose to a record 12.8 percent from 12.7 percent.
